Not checked because it may be an image: the cover (artwork, title type, seal and social icons). Headings: the page-2 title, the five dark section bands of pages 2-5 ('Selected Performance Indicators', 'Balance Sheet Details', 'Income Statement Details', 'Performance by Asset Category', 'Notes to Users'), the underlined sub-headings 'Assets', 'Liabilities and Net Worth', 'Changes to Quarterly Credit Union Data Summary', 'Previous Changes' (printed with a colon) and 'Data Source and Additional Resources', and the table-page title printed on pages 11-14 (listed once; the one-to-one match needs one heading line). The section bands inside the tables ('Summary Credit Union Data', 'Delinquency', ...) are table rows, not headings. Tables: the page-5 table and the page-12 table are complete; the page-6 part of the changes table and the page-11 and page-13 tables are PARTIAL (row ranges in the table names; page 14, the same income rows as percent of average assets, is not transcribed). In the 18-column tables the first header row holds the group headers ('End of year quarter' over 2019.4-2023.4, 'Same quarter as current, previous years' over 2020.2-2024.2, 'Most recent four quarters' over 2024.3-2025.2, 'Most Recent' over the two change columns), each written in the first column it spans; its first two cells are empty; header cells on two lines are written joined ('4 Quarter % change'). Each section band (dark row across the table) is a row with its text in the first cell. Row labels are written without their indentation; superscript note marks in labels are written as the superscript digits ¹ ² ³ ⁴ attached to the word (NFKC makes them plain digits). Cells printed '.' are written '.'; cells printed '--' are left empty (not scored; the dash code points cannot be seen), as are blank cells. Negative values and the hyphens in labels ('state-chartered', 'low-income', 'Non-commercial', 'Fixed-rate', 'charge-offs', 'non-interest', 'Year-to-date', 'Long-term') are written with ASCII hyphen-minus (assumed). In the changes table a cell merged down over several rows has its text in the top row and empty strings below; multi-line cells are written joined with spaces. Arithmetic checked while typing: page 11 federal + state-chartered = federally insured credit unions in all 14 columns, the four-quarter change columns = 2025.2 minus 2024.2 (to the printed rounding) and the percent change columns = that change over 2024.2, the growth rows match the year-on-year change of their total rows where both quarters are printed; page 12 and page 13 change columns likewise; page 13 gross income = total interest income + total non-interest income and total non-interest income = fee income + other income + gains (within 0.2). must_contain: 44 phrases, each printed once, none crossing a page break; 2 are table cells of the changes table, 1 a footnote and 1 a table note; phrases avoid every hyphen ('state-chartered', 'low-income', 'non-interest', 'Risk-Based', '1- to 4-family'), the dashes, the curly apostrophes ('system’s', 'NCUA’s') and quotation marks. Bullet lead-ins in bold are outside the phrases where the phrase starts after them. Sentences repeated between the page-2 summary and pages 3-4 were not used unless their wording differs. ordered: 8 anchors on pages 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10 and 11. Noise: none; the pages carry only page numbers ('i', 'ii', '1'), too short to count; the table title, header rows and 'N/M – Not Meaningful' note repeated on pages 11-14 belong to the tables, not to page furniture. Absent: the text is ragged-right without one-word hyphenation (line ends fall in compounds or URLs), so absent is empty. BLIND PROTOCOL: chosen and answered before any converter or text extractor was run on the file; every check was typed from the rendered pages (pdftoppm at 100-220 dpi, read as images), and the PDF text layer was never read. Consequences: (1) text that may be an image (logos, seals, signatures, chart art) is not checked; (2) invisible text-layer content cannot be known, so noise lists only VISIBLE repeated page furniture; (3) where the exact code point of a glyph cannot be seen (curly vs straight quotes, dash and minus variants), must_contain phrases and ordered anchors avoid it; headings, table cells and absent entries that cannot avoid it are noted per file.
